title: SRTM-derived 3 Second Digital Elevation Model
selection_reason: A nationally consistent authoritative elevation source at a practical size for repeatable VECA regional analysis. The ~90 m source is resampled to a 250 m analytical surface; higher-resolution elevation remains available for later shortlisted-region work.
assurance_notes: Rasterio/GDAL opened the complete local AIG dataset and confirmed the expected CRS, dimensions, extent, dtype and nodata semantics.
Independent direct source samples were plausible at Brisbane 20 m, Sydney 72 m, Melbourne 27 m, Wagga Wagga 184 m, Katoomba 1020 m and Mount Kosciuszko 2220 m.
The full 250 m VECA derivative completed successfully with all six derived-surface sanity checks passing.
The large local source and generated GeoTIFF/XYZ derivatives are intentionally excluded from Git; provenance, processing code and acceptance metrics are committed.
